children: UK pizza chain operator's H1 2026 revenue grew 7.1% yr/yr, system sales up 20.6%
Company returned to profit in H1, posting £66,000 versus a loss in H1 2025
Revenue growth lagged system sales due to transition to franchise-led model
Company expects to trade in line with market expectations for the full year
DP Poland focused on advancing franchise-led model and accelerating Pizzeria 105 conversions
Margin improvement expected from further corporate-store disposals and supply-chain efficiencies
NETWORK EXPANSION - Co said system sales growth was driven by expansion of store network and positive like-for-like sales in Poland and Croatia
FRANCHISE TRANSITION - Transition to franchise-led model resulted in lower revenue growth relative to system sales, but improved margins
PIZZERIA 105 CONVERSIONS - Converted stores delivered sales growth, though conversion pace was slower than expected
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the restaurants & bars peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for DP Poland PLC is GBp14.00, about 115.4% above its September 14 closing price of GBp6.50
The stock recently traded at 145 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 179 three months ago
Sept 14 - Essar buys UK petrol station operator SGN Retail, adds 118 sites
Sept 14 - UK government hosts meeting with business leaders to discuss growth
